retrieved_synopses: Nested dialog used for Karlach upgrades in Dammon's default dialogues.
Follow up OM between Karlach and Dammon to give her her upgrades if she has infernal metal in her inventory.

Players find Dammon in HAV or LOW for the first or second time in the game with Karlach in your party. He will say that he knows a way to upgrade Karlach for the first or second time, depending on how her origin story evolved.
Lorroakan's dialoge after winning the fight against Nightsong. In gameplay he will attempt to fit her into the soul cage device (after this dialogue-- this should remain bronze).
Dialog from Dammon in the Act3, when we meet him while in his shop.
context: This nested dialog is used when the party encounters Dammon (typically in HAV or LOW) to have Karlach upgraded—often because she has infernal metal in her inventory—linking into Dammon’s default and follow-up lines about forging her heart. Off-screen, Karlach hands the metal to Dammon and he briefly forges it; he then returns the finished piece and Karlach fits the upgrade herself (the actual installation is shown only partially or from behind). Dammon’s delivery is a little wary/sad because he has some bad news for her, and his “same as last time” line explains that she must install it herself. The exchange supports optional player actions (for example the player can lay a hand on Karlach) and is one of several possible first- or second-upgrade scenes.
